lines.en: label soccer30:
scene black
scene mikudayrun1
I show up at the[school] much earlier than normal after deciding to skip my morning coffee.
lines.zh: 决定省掉早上的咖啡之后，我比平时早得多地出现在[school]。

lines.en: Now that I’m here, however, I’m definitely regretting the decision.
lines.zh: 然而等我到了这儿，我绝对开始后悔这个决定了。

lines.en: Not only is this particular morning much colder than it should be for what is {i}technically{/i} still summer, but there’s no one anywhere to be found.
lines.zh: 不光是这个早晨比{i}名义上{/i}还是夏天该有的温度冷得多，而且四下里一个人都找不到。

lines.en: I guess it’s too early for even someone like Miku to show up and start...running around in circles or whatever it is she does when she’s the only one here.
lines.zh: 看来连 Miku 那样的人也不会这么早出现，开始……绕着圈跑，或者她一个人在这儿时干的其他什么的。

lines.en: A thought suddenly crosses my mind along with a strong gust of wind as I stand before an empty bench, too afraid to sit down and feel how cold it would be against me.
lines.zh: 我站在一张空长椅前，一阵强风吹过，一个念头突然闪进脑海——我根本不敢坐下，怕感受它有多冰。

lines.en: If winter is truly right around the corner, what is going to happen to soccer practice?
lines.zh: 如果冬天真的近在眼前，足球训练会变成什么样？

lines.en: Are all of the girls still going to show up every day when it starts dropping to freezing temperatures?
lines.zh: 等气温降到冰点，女生们还会天天来吗？

lines.en: Does Kumon-mi even get that cold?
lines.zh: Kumon-mi 真会冷到那种程度吗？

lines.en: scene mikudayrun2
Out of nowhere, Miku comes running toward me from around the corner.
lines.zh: Miku 不知从哪儿拐过弯，朝我跑了过来。

lines.en: Her eyes widen when she realizes I’m here already, and I’m a bit curious as to why she’s wearing pants when she has practice this morning.
lines.zh: 发现我已经在这儿，她眼睛一下子瞪大了；而我有点好奇，明明早上有训练，她为什么穿着长裤。

lines.en: The hoodie I can understand, but I’m pretty sure pants aren’t the best for a sport that so-heavily involves lower body movement.
lines.zh: 连帽衫我能理解，但我敢肯定，对一项这么依赖下半身动作的运动来说，长裤可不是最佳选择。

lines.en: scene mikudayrun3
: M-Morning, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 早、早上好，老师！

lines.en: : What brings ya here so early? Also, isn’t it a little too cold to be wearin’ that same ole’ blazer?
lines.zh: : 你怎么这么早就来了？还有，穿那件老掉牙的西装外套，是不是有点太冷了？

lines.en: : Where’s your winter jacket? Your scarf? Your gloves?
lines.zh: : 你的冬装外套呢？围巾呢？手套呢？

lines.en: : Ya gotta be prepared or you’ll wind up catchin’ a cold and we’ll get a substitute teacher who actually {i}teaches{/i} us stuff.
lines.zh: : 你得做好准备，不然会感冒，然后我们就会换一个真的会{i}教{/i}东西的代课老师。

lines.en: : That sounds horrible.
lines.zh: : 听起来糟透了。

lines.en: scene mikudayrun4
: It would be! I don’t even know if I remember how to write my own name.
lines.zh: : 就是很糟！我都不确定自己还记不记得怎么写自己的名字。

lines.en: : Please tell me you’re exaggerating.
lines.zh: : 请告诉我你在夸张。

lines.en: : That seems like too much even for you.
lines.zh: : 就算是你，这也太夸张了。

lines.en: scene mikudayrun5
: Course I am. I practiced writin’ my name a bunch of times when I was little since I thought I’d be signin’ autographs and stuff once I got to college.
lines.zh: : 当然是夸张啦。我小时候练过好多次写自己的名字，因为我觉得上了大学就要签什么名之类的。

lines.en: : Still think you have a chance to make it there?
lines.zh: : 你还觉得自己有机会上大学吗？

lines.en: : Make it where? College or autographs?
lines.zh: : 上哪儿？上大学还是签名？

lines.en: : Both?...
: Probably not, but I try not to think too much about that anymore.
lines.zh: : 大概都不行，不过我尽量不再想这些了。

lines.en: : Besides, now that it’s gettin’ all cold and stuff, I'm havin' a hard time focusin' anyway.
lines.zh: : 再说，现在天越来越冷什么的，我本来就很难集中注意力。

lines.en: : I was actually just thinking, is anything about soccer practice going to change when winter rolls around?
lines.zh: : 其实我刚才就在想，等冬天来了，足球训练会有什么变化吗？

lines.en: scene mikudayrun6
: Mm...I don’t really know.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我不太清楚。

lines.en: : I’m a first-year so I haven’t ever seen how this[school] handles that sorta thing before.
lines.zh: : 我是高一，还没见过这所[school]是怎么处理这种事的。

lines.en: : But if it’s anythin’ like my middle[school] was, I don’t think much should change. Some girls will probably just bring hoodies or somethin’.
lines.zh: : 不过如果跟我的初中差不多，那应该没什么大变化。有些女生大概会带件连帽衫什么的。

lines.en: : Are they going to be bringing pants, too?
lines.zh: : 那她们也会穿长裤吗？

lines.en: scene mikudayrun7
: Why do ya ask, Sensei? Afraid of missin’ out on some of that good ole exposed [teenager] skin?
lines.zh: : 老师你问这个干嘛？怕看不到那些[teenager]露出来的好皮肤吗？

lines.en: : That and the fact that you’re wearing pants right now.
lines.zh: : 这个，再加上你现在穿着长裤。

lines.en: scene mikudayrun8
: Oh. Well, ya see, there’s actually a good reason for that.
lines.zh: : 哦。那个嘛，其实是有点原因的。

lines.en: : That reason wouldn’t happen to involve what went down in your dorm room recently, would it?
lines.zh: : 该不会跟你最近在宿舍里发生的事有关吧？

lines.en: : Are those pants your anti-Sensei barrier?
lines.zh: : 那条裤子是你的「防老师屏障」吗？

lines.en: scene mikudayrun9
: What? Nononono. It’s nothin’ like that.
lines.zh: : 什么？不不不不。才不是那么回事。

lines.en: : Besides, there are much easier ways to prevent ya from gettin’ all handsy with me if I don’t want ya to.
lines.zh: : 再说，我要是真不想让你动手动脚，有的是更简单的办法。

lines.en: : Sounds ominous. You don’t carry any weapons around, do you?
lines.zh: : 听着挺吓人。你不会随身带着什么武器吧？

lines.en: scene mikudayrun10
: No weapons here, just the heart of a warrior!
lines.zh: : 没有武器，只有一颗战士之心！

lines.en: : The real reason I’m not dressed in my jersey today is that we’re skippin’ practice on account of everybody bein' sick.
lines.zh: : 我今天没穿队服的真正原因是，大家都病了，所以训练取消了。

lines.en: : A bunch of the girls went out to some yakiniku place last night and all wound up with food poisoning.
lines.zh: : 昨晚一群女生去吃烤肉，结果全都食物中毒了。

lines.en: : So you’re here all by yourself? Why not just sleep in?
lines.zh: : 所以你一个人在这儿？干嘛不多睡会儿？

lines.en: scene mikudayrun11
: I can’t sleep in or I’ll miss out on the exercise I need to prevent my body from going all wibbly-wobbly whenever I’m playin’ soccer.
lines.zh: : 我不能赖床，不然就少了必要的锻炼，踢球的时候身体会变得软趴趴的。

lines.en: scene mikudayrun12
: And also I...thought I might run into ya here and stuff.
lines.zh: : 而且我也……想着说不定能在这儿碰上你什么的。

lines.en: : So you woke up extra early on the weekend and came all the way to[school] in your normal clothes because you thought you might see me?
lines.zh: : 所以你周末特意早起，穿着便服大老远跑到[school]，就因为觉得可能会见到我？

lines.en: : Don’t forget about the exercise part. It’s not {i}just{/i} because of you. That’s just a little bonus I guess.
lines.zh: : 别忘了锻炼那部分。也不{i}全{/i}是因为你。那个大概算是一点附赠的福利吧。

lines.en: Adorable.
lines.zh: 真可爱。

lines.en: : Well, I’m glad I wound up coming here then. It will give the two of us a chance to talk about stuff.
lines.zh: : 那我庆幸自己还是来了。这样我们俩就有机会聊聊了。

lines.en: scene mikudayrun13
: This isn’t gonna be one of those adult talks about the dangers of babymakin’, is it? Cause we got real close recently and I definitely ain’t ready for that.
lines.zh: : 该不会是那种「造人有多危险」的大人谈话吧？因为我们最近走得挺近的，我可绝对没准备好听这个。

lines.en: : Okay well first, we did not come anywhere close to “babymaking.”
lines.zh: : 好吧，首先，我们离「造人」远着呢。

lines.en: : Secondly, I mean more about just...discussing normal stuff.
lines.zh: : 其次，我的意思是……聊聊普通的事。

lines.en: : You said you wanted to get to know me better, and I don’t really know anything about you either other than that you play soccer and don’t like loud noises.
lines.zh: : 你说过想更了解我，而我对你也一无所知，只知道你踢足球、不喜欢吵闹的声音。

lines.en: scene mikudayrun14
: That’s pretty much all I’ve got. If you’re lookin’ for someone more unique, you’re probably better off with somebody like Kirin.
lines.zh: : 我差不多就这些了。你要是想找个更有个性的人，还是去找 Kirin 那种的比较好。

lines.en: if kirindate10 == True or ayanelust10 == True:
Well, she’s definitely right about Kirin being...unique.
lines.zh: 嗯，她说 Kirin 很「有个性」，倒是一点没错。

lines.en: I’m not quite sure if that’s a good thing yet, though.
lines.zh: 不过我还不确定这算不算好事。

lines.en: : Well then it shouldn’t be a difficult conversation since I don’t have much interesting to say either.
lines.zh: : 那这对话应该不难，因为我也没什么有意思的事可说。

lines.en: scene mikudayrun15
: Really? No crazy stories about what it’s like lookin’ after Ami?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？没有讲讲照顾 Ami 是什么感觉的疯狂故事？

lines.en: : I think it’s closer to Ami looking after me, to tell you the truth.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我觉得更像是 Ami 在照顾我。

lines.en: In all fairness, though, it’s not like I know anything about how things were beforehand.
lines.zh: 不过平心而论，我对之前的情况本来也一无所知。

lines.en: That’s probably something I’ll need to hear from Ami or Ayane directly before I jump to any conclusions about how difficult things were.
lines.zh: 在下判断说那段日子有多难之前，我大概得先听 Ami 或 Ayane 亲口说。

lines.en: : Do you want to go sit down somewhere, maybe?
lines.zh: : 要不要找个地方坐下来？

lines.en: : I’m starting to feel a little odd just standing on this pathway talking about...whatever we’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 就这么站在小路上聊……聊的这些，我开始觉得有点怪了。

lines.en: : A whole lotta nothin’, if ya ask me. But yeah, we can go sit.
lines.zh: : 要我说，全是一堆废话。不过行，我们去坐吧。

lines.en: scene mikudayrun16
: There’s a spot I ran past earlier that the sunlight can reach. We probably won’t freeze our butts off like we would on one of the benches either.
lines.zh: : 我刚才跑过一个地方，阳光照得到。而且我们大概也不会像坐长椅那样把屁股冻僵。

lines.en: : Nothin’ worse than a cold bench, ya know?
lines.zh: : 没什么比冷板凳更糟的了，你知道吗？

lines.en: : I mean, there are definitely worse things. But yeah, take me to your secret sunspot.
lines.zh: : 我是说，更糟的事肯定有。不过行吧，带我去你的秘密阳光角落。

lines.en: : Heheh...it’s not a secret. It’s just a corner of the[school] building.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……算不上秘密。就是[school]楼的一个角落。

lines.en: : Come with me and you’ll see!
lines.zh: : 跟我来你就知道了！

lines.en: scene black
Miku begins to walk alongside me and it feels rather...odd.
lines.zh: Miku 开始走在我旁边，这感觉相当……怪。

lines.en: It’s never occurred to me before but I don’t normally see her walking. Like, ever.
lines.zh: 我之前从没意识到，我基本上没见过她走路。真的，从来没有。

lines.en: Even on the rare occasions where we’ve gone out at night during one of my dorm-visits, it’s always centered around jogging.
lines.zh: 就连少数几次我夜访宿舍和她一起出门，也总是绕着慢跑转。

lines.en: It’s good knowing that Miku has a lower setting as well.
lines.zh: 知道 Miku 也有低速档，挺好的。

lines.en: I like the high-velocity version, but a cold morning like this is definitely not ideal for the standard version of Miku, as far as I’m concerned.
lines.zh: 我挺喜欢高速版的，但就我而言，像这样一个寒冷的早晨显然不适合标准版的 Miku。

lines.en: scene mikudayrun17
The light filters through the clouds and spills onto us as we step into a sun-soaked sanctuary on the side of the[school].
lines.zh: 我们走进[school]侧边那片洒满阳光的避风港，阳光穿过云层倾泻在我们身上。

lines.en: Miku leans up against the wall and I decide to take my place in front of her instead of off to her side.
lines.zh: Miku 靠在墙上，而我决定站到她面前，而不是她旁边。

lines.en: Sure, my section is a little closer to the shade, but if we’re actually going to be {i}talking{/i} to each other for once, it might be helpful to see her face.
lines.zh: 当然，我这边离阴影近一点，不过如果我们这次真要好好{i}聊{/i}一聊，能看到她的脸也许有帮助。

lines.en: Not to mention, I like her face quite a bit. It’s a good face.
lines.zh: 更别说我还挺喜欢她的脸的。是张好脸。

lines.en: : Sooooo...what did you want to talk about?
lines.zh: : 那那那……你想聊什么？

lines.en: : I can go on and on about most stuff, but when it comes to this openin’ up kinda thing, I just sorta freeze up.
lines.zh: : 大多数话题我能说个没完，但一碰到这种敞开心扉的事，我就会有点卡壳。

lines.en: : Is that like, a confidence issue or something?
lines.zh: : 那算是……自信心方面的问题吗？

lines.en: scene mikudayrun18
: Uhh...no. No, that’s not it at all.
lines.zh: : 呃……不。完全不是那么回事。

lines.en: : Just that there’s some stuff that’s happened to me in the past that’s not really fun to talk about.
lines.zh: : 只是我过去发生过一些事，讲起来并不怎么愉快。

lines.en: : I told you that in my dorm a while ago, didn't I? After the first time ya saw me actin' all weird.
lines.zh: : 我之前在宿舍里跟你说过吧？就是你第一次看到我举止奇怪之后。

lines.en: : I don’t like feelin’ weak, so I try to push it away as much as I can. But there’s only so much I can push, ya know?
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢觉得自己软弱，所以尽量把这些推开。但能推开的也就那么多，你懂吧？

lines.en: : I’m strong, but I’ve got tiny arms. Pushin’ stuff can be hard.
lines.zh: : 我是挺强的，可我胳膊细。推东西有时候挺难的。

lines.en: Oh, this is a good opportunity to be deep.
lines.zh: 哦，这是个发挥深沉的好机会。

lines.en: : You know Miku, I can-
lines.zh: : 你知道吗 Miku，我可以——

lines.en: scene mikudayrun19
: You can help me push things that are too heavy for me to push on my own. I know.
lines.zh: : 你可以帮我推开那些我自己推不动的重物。我知道。

lines.en: : What the hell? You stole my moment.
lines.zh: : 什么鬼？你抢了我的台词。

lines.en: scene mikudayrun20
: Yup! Makoto said the same thing when I brought up the arm thing before. And you’re really just the boy version of her.
lines.zh: : 对呀！我之前提胳膊那事的时候，Makoto 也说过一模一样的话。而你真的就是她的男生版。

lines.en: : Err, actually no. I {i}used{/i} to think you were like the boy version of her. But now you’re like...just a boy.
lines.zh: : 呃，其实不是。我{i}以前{/i}觉得你是她的男生版。可现在你就……只是个男生。

lines.en: : But you two still have glasses and talk the same so I guess you’re kinda still similar.
lines.zh: : 不过你俩都戴眼镜，说话方式也一样，所以我想还是有点像的。

lines.en: : Well it’s good knowing that I remind you of your best friend.
lines.zh: : 知道我能让你想起你最好的朋友，还挺好的。

lines.en: : Yup!
lines.zh: : 对呀！

lines.en: scene mikudayrun21
: Can’t say Makoto’s ever tried to put her fingers in me before, though, so that’s a thing we’ve gotta take into account now.
lines.zh: : 不过 Makoto 可从没把手指伸进过我身体，这一点现在得考虑进去。

lines.en: : So really, the only things Makoto and I have in common in your head are...glasses and the way we talk.
lines.zh: : 所以到头来，在你脑子里我和 Makoto 的共同点就只有……眼镜和说话方式。

lines.en: : I coulda sworn there was more but I guess not.
lines.zh: : 我明明觉得还有别的，看来是没有。

lines.en: scene mikudayrun22
: Do you have any cool stuff you want to tell me about {i}your{/i} past since I don’t wanna talk about mine, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 既然我不想聊我的过去，老师你有没有什么有意思的{i}你{/i}的过去可以讲讲？

lines.en: : Like I said the other day, I don’t know anything about you. Tell me some stuff.
lines.zh: : 就像我前几天说的，我对你一无所知。跟我说说吧。

lines.en: : Like, when did ya realize you liked thighs so much?
lines.zh: : 比如，你是什么时候发现自己这么喜欢大腿的？

lines.en: : Probably the first time I saw them but that’s not really something I can talk about at length.
lines.zh: : 大概是我第一次见到的时候吧，不过这实在没什么好细说的。

lines.en: At least not with Miku. I’m not trying to scare her off when we’re finally becoming closer.
lines.zh: 至少不能跟 Miku 细说。我们好不容易走近了，我可不想把她吓跑。

lines.en: : That’s like me and soccer!
lines.zh: : 这跟我和足球一样！

lines.en: : The first time I ever saw a game, I was totally hooked!
lines.zh: : 我第一次看比赛就彻底上瘾了！

lines.en: : Sure, soccer is a lot more innocent to get hooked on than a girl’s legs, but I can kinda understand more about your interests now.
lines.zh: : 当然，迷上足球可比迷上女生的腿清白多了，不过我现在多少能理解你的兴趣了。

lines.en: : Can you really, though?
lines.zh: : 你真能理解吗？

lines.en: scene mikudayrun23
: Course I can! A hobby is a hobby is a hobby is a hobby!
lines.zh: : 当然能！兴趣就是兴趣就是兴趣就是兴趣！

lines.en: : I think you said “hobby” a few too many times there.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你「兴趣」说了太多遍了。

lines.en: scene mikudayrun24
: I don’t think so. Hobbies are important.
lines.zh: : 我不这么觉得。兴趣很重要。

lines.en: : Ya never know when ya need somethin’ like that to help you get yer mind off of stuff.
lines.zh: : 说不定什么时候你就需要这么个东西，帮你把心思从别的事上挪开。

lines.en: : One of the big reasons I’m as into soccer as I am is that it helps me push away all of that sad stuff I was hinting at earlier.
lines.zh: : 我这么迷足球的一大原因，就是它能帮我把刚才暗示的那些伤心事推开。

lines.en: : Soccer makes it so I don’t need to ask people like you and Makoto for an extra set of arms when things get tough.
lines.zh: : 有了足球，日子难过的时候我就不用向你和 Makoto 这样的人再借一双手。

lines.en: : Just like in sports, sometimes you just need to push through.
lines.zh: : 就像运动一样，有时候你只能硬撑过去。

lines.en: Miku begins spewing out a bunch of positivity despite hiding something so big from me that she breaks down whenever she hears a loud noise.
lines.zh: Miku 开始滔滔不绝地输出一堆正能量，尽管她对我隐瞒着那么大的一件事——大到她一听到巨响就会崩溃。

lines.en: Thankfully, there are no loud noises around in this quiet pre-winter morning, so she is able to maintain the illusion of happiness for the time being.
lines.zh: 所幸在这个初冬的安静清晨，四周没有巨响，所以她暂时还能维持住幸福的假象。

lines.en: Of course, that illusion is bound to come crashing down at any minute and she’ll need to think up a brand new justification for why she’s disguising her past.
lines.zh: 当然，那层假象随时都会崩塌，到时她又得想出一个全新的理由，来解释自己为什么要掩饰过去。

lines.en: What the hell happened to her and why is it worth putting on airs to tuck away?
lines.zh: 她到底经历过什么，值得她这样装模作样地藏起来？

lines.en: scene mikudayrun25
: Woah! Where’d that angry face come from?
lines.zh: : 哇哦！你那张生气的脸是哪来的？

lines.en: : If I knew ya hated positive outlooks so much I would have just started cryin’ and punchin’ the wall or somethin’.
lines.zh: : 我要是知道你这么讨厌积极向上，我就该干脆哭出来、捶墙什么的。

lines.en: : Don’t punch the wall. It’s made of stone and you’ll hurt your hand.
lines.zh: : 别捶墙。那是石头做的，你会把手弄伤。

lines.en: : Then snap the heck out of it and look at me normally again!
lines.zh: : 那你就赶紧回神，用正常的眼神看我！

lines.en: scene mikudayrun26
: If we’re gonna be spendin’ the mornin’ together, I wanna do it with smiles on our faces. None of that “I’m a bad-guy teacher! Rawr!” mumbo-jumbo.
lines.zh: : 既然我们要一起过这个上午，我希望我们脸上都带着笑。别搞那套「我是坏老师！嗷呜！」的鬼话。

lines.en: : I have never once {i}rawr’ed{/i} at you, Miku.
lines.zh: : 我可从来没有对你{i}「嗷呜」{/i}过，Miku。

lines.en: : Not yet! But you look like you’re about to!
lines.zh: : 还没有！可你看起来马上就要了！

lines.en: scene mikudayrun27
: Oh! I know! Let’s talk about anime! Lemme tell ya all about this tournament arc thingy I watched with Makoto last night!
lines.zh: : 哦！有了！我们聊动画吧！让我跟你好好讲讲昨晚和 Makoto 一起看的那个比赛篇！

lines.en: : Makoto watches anime?
lines.zh: : Makoto 也看动画？

lines.en: : Of course! Now, listen up-
lines.zh: : 当然啦！听好了——

lines.en: scene black
Miku goes on to talk about a bunch of things I have to pretend to be interested in in order to avoid bringing her down any more than my face from several minutes ago did.
lines.zh: Miku 接着聊了一大堆我得装作感兴趣的事，免得让她比我几分钟前那张脸弄得还要低落。

lines.en: The rest of the morning flies by and, before we know it, the sunspot consumes all of Kumon-mi and converts a temporary, cool sanctuary into another scorching nightmare.
lines.zh: 上午剩下的时间飞快过去，不知不觉间，阳光吞没了整个 Kumon-mi，把这片暂时的清凉避难所变成了又一场灼热的噩梦。

lines.en: But at least it’s a nightmare Miku is able to smile in.
lines.zh: 但至少，这是一场 Miku 还能笑出来的噩梦。

lines.en: $ soccer30 = True
$ miku_love += 1
{i}Miku’s affection has increased to [miku_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Miku 的好感度提升到了 [miku_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdayafternoon
